A registry holding only unparseable junk is silence (fail-open), never a block or an error.
Seven undelivered completions: the first Stop delivers the five oldest by endedAt, the second the remaining two, the third releases.

A completion left undelivered by a previous session is adopted by the new session at SessionStart (adoptedBy, ledger 'adopted'), announced with the affordance line, and then delivered by that session's Stop.
With the off flag set, SessionStart still adopts the orphaned completion (ownership only) but injects nothing.
This session already owns a delivered job: nothing to adopt, so SessionStart injects only the `cxc bg list` affordance line.
`bg --help`, bare `bg` and an unknown verb all print the usage block and exit 0 (there is no help flag; anything unknown is usage); `bg run` without `--` prints usage and exits 1 without spawning.
